scope: Chromium automatic playback from scenario 32 through visibly held scenario 36. Compare the complete actor entries, holds, and exits for 33–35, and the entry and hold for 36.

browser.transport: Published PlayerPanel and iframe in a temporary same-origin wrapper; public scripts and media loaded directly.
browser.frameCadence: Compositor-driven samples rather than a fixed frame rate, with long gaps during unchanged presentation.

actorComparison.sourceObservation: Felt fades in with open eyes at about 559.222 seconds, then closes them with her arms lowered and holds the expression into the fade.
actorComparison.browserObservation: Open-eyed fade-in between frames 252 and 278, half-closed at 287, eyes closed by 295, held until the outgoing fade.
actorComparison.result: Main expression transition and hold agree visually. Exact timing and all gesture details remain unaccepted.

actorComparison.sourceObservation: Julius enters with an open-eyed smile and then holds a closed-eye smile. Eyes are closed by about 565.8 seconds and the expression persists into the 568.055–568.188 second fade.
actorComparison.browserObservation: An open-eyed smile is visible during entry, at text and speech onset, after the speech, and late in the hold. The rendered mouth moves during the saved cue.
actorComparison.result: The source closed-eye smile remains missing. Two independent reviewers saw the open-eye hold in the current capture.

actorComparison.sourceObservation: Felt enters open-eyed with her arms lowered, then briefly closes her eyes and holds a more concerned brow with subtle mouth and head motion.
actorComparison.browserObservation: Open-eyed, lowered-arm entry agrees visually. Reviewed frames 829–1056 keep the eyes open, with a calmer hold around the eyes and brow.
actorComparison.result: Entry agreement and hold-expression difference observed.

actorComparison.sourceObservation: Julius has a brief closed-eye entry at 574.555–574.688 seconds. The following hold has a more serious brow and mouth.
actorComparison.browserObservation: Open-eyed smiling entry and a small smile during the hold. Reviewed frames 1083–1323 keep the eyes open, with mouth movement at dialogue onset.
actorComparison.result: Entry and hold expressions differ. The capture ends before the source exit flash and cannot compare that effect.
